originalReview.notes: Native original already cleared in Qualla individually inspected. Two exterior wall close-ups resolve three stepped angular ribs/folds per block and the concrete relief depth; lawn view shows the courtyard arcade and low guest-room elevations, partly obscured by trees. Exact own-work PD-self creator grant, clean no-attribution/no-restrictions metadata and native SHA-1/SHA-256 bound. New relief is a simplified original interpretation, not an exact mold. Photographs dated2009; condition/placement of every later block is not measured.
